name: How long does it take to complete an accessory dwelling unit?
description: Most builds require four to nine months of active construction, excluding preliminary design development and municipal permitting review periods.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete an accessory dwelling unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Constructing an ADU typically takes between four and nine months once construction begins, but pre-construction planning impacts the overall schedule. Site assessments, custom architectural drawings, and city or county permit reviews can take several additional months before crews break ground. During construction, the timeline depends on unit type; garage conversions finish faster than standalone new construction, while material lead times, drywall finishing, and scheduling mandatory trade inspections also influence project duration.
